status: Source and synthetic design only; no actual market evaluation authorized by this document

provenance.baseline_findings_received_from_parent: Full inner six-family learner failed its risk requirements; frequent support-family infeasibility led to long exposed pending holds. The negative baseline is retained, not overwritten or reinterpreted as success.

single_intervention: Change only the physical action at the first funded primary no-feasible-proposal decision: one best-effort protective action, then the same absorbing Review hold. All remaining account mechanics and initial/actual-breach handling are unchanged.
unchanged: same own-training Q1 fits and original positive base target
same primary13 safe points and exact fee geometry
same whole-policy inner selector and service alpha/tail gates
same originalH/CPI/peak/runningMDD and actual strict crossing
same absorbing guard/actual-breach continuation and full financial denominators

API.decide: decide_state_action has the frozen V2 signature, calls frozen primary first and adds mitigation witnesses without mutating any primary module global.
API.mitigation: mitigate_support_failure(holdings,cpi,support_real_gross,*,target,cost_rate=.0025,budget_floor,forecast_real_gross=None,forecast_weights=None,real_peak=None,running_mdd=None,L=None). Optional complete forecast/history inputs add9 candidate growth/risk annotations; support worst wealth alone selects the point.
API.implementation: Copy the already frozen V2 simulator function into the new module, importing its pure validators and primary decision helper. Add new fields and replace only the new module decision function; no monkeypatch, old source edit or selector change.

permission_to_mitigate.required: Active already-funded account; initial=False; frozen primary status=no_feasible_action; no guard pending and no previously recorded actual breach.
permission_to_mitigate.forbidden: Never rescue initial Review with a different allocation. Never trade anew after actual breach or a prior guard trigger. Identical known initial states retain identical initial admission.
permission_to_mitigate.state_transition: The mitigation period is still Review: guard_triggered=True, pending_at_decision=True, was_pending_input=False, automatic_service=False. The next and all later decisions are pending hold. was_pending_input=True always implies no new trade.
permission_to_mitigate.administrative_scope: The ordinary-service continuation fraction remains zero from the guard-trigger period even when a one-time protective action is executed automatically. It is not the fraction of every algorithmic action. Report mitigation counts, moved amounts and fees separately; there is no renewed automatic service or assumed human response.

nine_point_menu.destinations: a*w+(1-a)*e_bill for a=1,.75,.5,.25, the exact same four temporary destinations.
nine_point_menu.segment_points: For each destination compute exact full endpoint y_star and feeC_star, then q=.5 and1. y(q)=x+q*(y_star-x), fee=q*C_star, moved=q*moved_star. Destination and point order are fixed.
nine_point_menu.exact_funding: sum(y)+fee=sum(x); fee=kappa*sum(max(y-x,0)). The fee is already in post holdings and must never be charged twice.
nine_point_menu.objective: Maximize min_s (a_s dot y)/currentCPI over the declared own-training joint real-gross support. No empirical probability weights, eta or forecast growth score ranks this fallback menu.
nine_point_menu.strict_improvement: Let R=sum(x)/CPI. Trade only if chosen minimum next real wealth exceeds hold minimum by more than1e-12*R. A global maximum band of1e-12*R is applied; candidates not strictly improving hold are excluded from a positive-gain band.
nine_point_menu.tie: Hold first, then smaller actual nominal fee, smaller proposal index, then fixed q/point order. A plateau therefore need not select q=1.
nine_point_menu.no_improvement: If no strict supported improvement exists, choose hold with fee0 and still enter absorbing Review.

honesty.primary_witness: Every original13 candidate and interval field remains untouched. The failed primary gate reason/score/hold prediction and primary_failed_hold_* are saved separately.
honesty.actual_decision: actual_decision_source=primary/mitigation/pending; mitigation_selected_index identifies the actual9point arm. Actual post,fee,moved and scalar forecast loggrowth/paired advantage/gross advantage/logfee/next-shortfall describe the real mitigation action, not max(primary_index,0).
honesty.residual_shortfall: worst_real_shortfall_selected can remain positive; do not label the floor restored or issue a support safety certificate merely because it improved.
honesty.financial_units: Worst next real wealth and shortfall improvement are purchasing-power wealth units relative to initial real100. Fees/moved are nominal units. Shortfall value is evaluated after exact fees, not a benefit from subtracting the fee again.
honesty.adverse_results: Worst supported next-year improvement does not ensure higher realized growth, smaller realized MDD, future feasibility, support containment or a positive gain in every forecast. Preserve all such adverse results and full-H outcomes.

witnesses.primary: All13 original candidate/interval fields, selected_index and support_feasible remain from V2.
witnesses.account: Same original full physical state tree, pending flags and originalH metrics; both actual previous-state prefixes and post-action realized_real_gross remain available.

validation: Synthetic checks compare every shared V2 arm field exactly when mitigation is absent; preserve primary13 witnesses on a failed state; verify exact fee equations, worst-versus-mean distinction, fee reversal, plateau/global ties, strict relative improvement, residual failure, negative growth and adverse actual outcomes, no initial/breach rescue, one action then hold, and future/ID information isolation.

next_theory_only.name: Drawdown-modulated exposure cap
next_theory_only.idea: A next version could turn the current real headroom into an exposure cap before the primary family becomes infeasible, rather than intervening only afterwards. Keep this separate from the present one-factor fallback experiment.
next_theory_only.no_fee_fixed_postwealth_derivation: For risky-sleeve exposure e, per-row risky real gross r_s and bill gross b_s, a fixed post-fee real balance R_f would require R_f*((1-e)*b_s+e*r_s)>=F_rho. When b_s>r_s this yields e<=(b_s-F_rho/R_f)/(b_s-r_s); other slope signs yield lower bounds or no solution. Intersect every joint row and [0,1].
next_theory_only.exact_fee_boundary: R_f itself depends on the transition fee. A fee-free exposure formula cannot be transferred unchanged. Post-dollar parametrization retains linear inequalities with exact fees and original peak/CPI.
next_theory_only.limits: Bill real gross can be below1, so a nonnegative cap may not exist and cash is not guaranteed. One-step caps do not prove recursive feasibility or intrayear protection. Literature assumptions and any originality claim require separate source-backed review.
next_theory_only.design_boundary: No exposure-cap action, candidate or parameter is added to V2b. Such a policy needs a later independently declared version and complete nested development evaluation.

execution_gate: Only source/synthetic work here. Root will freeze a new additive protocol/runner/source closure before any development1-120 evaluation. This stage does not read121-180 or modify old V2/final artifacts.
